def transform(grid):
    """Tile a square grid with its four quarter-turn orientations."""
    n = len(grid)
    if not n or any(len(row) != n for row in grid):
        raise ValueError("expected a nonempty square grid")
    original = [list(row) for row in grid]
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*original[::-1])]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*original)][::-1]
    half_turn = [row[::-1] for row in original[::-1]]
    return [
        original[r] + clockwise[r] for r in range(n)
    ] + [
        counterclockwise[r] + half_turn[r] for r in range(n)
    ]
